notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 3 or greater.
You control up to four lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
Candelabra of Tawnos and Staff of Domination do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate up to four lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by tapping it and paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, untapping the up to four lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {1}, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
